title: Both Text and Images Leaked! A Systematic Analysis of Data Contamination in Multimodal LLM
authors_zh: Dingjie Song, Sicheng Lai, Mingxuan Wang, Shunian Chen, Lichao Sun, Benyou Wang
paper_type_zh: 污染、验证器、奖励或评测可靠性审计
best_for_zh: 需要测量多模态基准泄漏及模型评测可信度的研究者。
one_line: Accepted multimodal contamination audit with the authors’ MM-Detect public repository.
将文本与图像泄漏统一为多模态污染审计，并提供可复现的来源分析框架。
why: It adds an auditable reliability or failure-mode surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: contamination, verifier/reward failure, reward hacking, or evaluator reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multimodal benchmark results can be contaminated by leaked text, images, or their cross-modal pairing, while text-only tests miss part of this pathway. This can overstate multimodal capability.

MM-Detect defines unimodal and cross-modal contamination and audits 12 MLLMs on five benchmarks with an analysis framework and public code.

多模态基准结果可能受泄漏文本、图像或二者配对影响，而只查文本会漏掉部分路径，从而夸大多模态能力。

MM-Detect 定义单模态与跨模态污染，在五个基准上审计十二个多模态大模型，并提供分析框架和公开代码。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper unifies text and image leakage as a multimodal contamination audit. MM-Detect traces possible sources through white-, grey-, and black-box settings; its output is an audit signal, not a training dataset. The official repository provides code and datasets used by the workflow.
论文把文本和图像泄漏统一为多模态污染审计。MM-Detect 在白盒、灰盒和黑盒条件下追踪可能来源，输出审计信号而非训练数据集；官方仓库提供流程所用代码和数据。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Choose benchmark items and possible source corpora.
  1. Apply unimodal tests to text and images, then cross-modal tests to their pairing.
  1. Run the analysis in white-, grey-, or black-box access settings.
  1. Aggregate evidence into contamination and source reports. Model access, benchmark versions, prompts, and repository scripts must be fixed; some detector thresholds are unknown.

1. 选择基准题目与可能的来源语料。
  1. 对文本和图像做单模态测试，再测试二者配对的跨模态信号。
  1. 在白盒、灰盒或黑盒访问条件下运行分析。
  1. 聚合证据形成污染与来源报告。须固定模型访问、基准版本、提示词和仓库脚本；部分阈值未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The study audits 12 MLLMs over five benchmarks and reports substantial contamination, particularly for proprietary models and older benchmarks. Its source analysis indicates that leakage may arise from unimodal pretraining sources. This supports a multimodal audit requirement, but does not prove the exact training corpus for every model.
研究在五个基准上审计十二个多模态大模型，报告了显著污染，尤其涉及专有模型和较旧基准。来源分析提示泄漏可能来自单模态预训练源。这支持多模态审计的必要性，却不能逐一证明模型的确切训练语料。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Text-only contamination work cannot capture image leakage or cross-modal matching. MM-Detect changes the unit of audit from a textual item to text, image, and their relationship, and supports several model-access regimes. The novelty is this unified source-oriented audit rather than a new multimodal benchmark score.
文本污染研究无法覆盖图像泄漏或跨模态配对。MM-Detect 把审计单位从文本题目改为文本、图像及其关系，并支持多种模型访问条件。新意是统一且面向来源的审计，而不是新的多模态分数。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Results depend on available source corpora and model access; black-box inference cannot establish exact training provenance. The evaluation covers 12 models and five benchmarks, not every modality or release. Before reuse, freeze benchmark versions and distinguish direct evidence from source-attribution hypotheses.
结果依赖可获得的来源语料和模型访问权限；黑盒推断不能确证训练来源。评测只覆盖十二个模型、五个基准，而非所有模态或版本。复用前应冻结基准版本，并区分直接证据和来源归因假设。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For a multimodal benchmark owner, run MM-Detect on its text, image, and pair fields to produce a leakage report before publishing rankings. For a model audit, compare access settings and archive the source candidates. Do not interpret a detected similarity as definitive training-data proof without provenance evidence.
多模态基准维护者可对文本、图像和配对字段运行 MM-Detect，在发布排行前生成泄漏报告。模型审计者可比较不同访问条件并归档来源候选。没有出处证据时，不应把检测到的相似性当成训练数据的确定证明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: text-only checks miss image and pair-level leakage.
  1. Handle: test unimodal and cross-modal signals under three access regimes.
  1. Artifact: code and workflow are public in MM-Detect.
  1. Evidence: 12 MLLMs and five benchmarks reveal substantial contamination.
  1. Reuse: preserve benchmark versions and separate detection from attribution.

1. 定位：只查文本会漏掉图像与配对泄漏。
  1. 抓手：在三种访问条件下测试单模态和跨模态信号。
  1. 产物：MM-Detect 公开了代码与流程。
  1. 证据：十二个模型、五个基准显示显著污染。
  1. 复用：保留基准版本，区分检测与归因。
